prompts.inventory:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Stardew Valley mod INVENTORY SPRITESHEET. Create a SINGLE transparent 2:1 landscape atlas with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND TWO ROWS, eight equal square cells. Logical canvas 64x32 pixels, each cell 16x16 pixels, shown enlarged as crisp nearest-neighbor pixel art. Every sprite centered with 1 logical pixel transparent padding, consistent large square pixels.
ROW 1 left to right, four harvested fictional medicinal plants:
1 GLASS DEWBERRY: a short curved sprig with exactly THREE oversized round sky-blue translucent glass-marble berries and two small deep teal leaves. Thick dark blue contours, cobalt lower-right crescent shadows, turquoise interiors and a bold ivory square highlight plus reflected cyan edge. The berries must dominate the icon, like beautiful blue glass marbles.
2 MOONVELVET: a short sprig of TWO drooping rounded pale-lavender bell flowers, plum throats, two rounded velvety sage-green leaves with a creamy silver edge. Compact chunky flower silhouette, not lavender spikes.
3 AMBER HEARTLEAF: TWO round heart-shaped amber-gold leaves with red-brown veins on one reddish stem, one tiny warm orange resin droplet nestled at their base. Botanical leaves, not a bottle.
4 SILVER SEAMLEAF: a tight fan of THREE long pointed silvery mint leaves, a clearly visible pale central stitch-like vein, one tiny ivory flower. Crisp cool gray-green palette, no berries.
ROW 2 left to right: FOUR kraft-paper seed packets, one corresponding to the plant immediately above. Squat ivory/kraft packets with folded ochre top, simple little plant emblem (blue round berry, purple bell, amber heart leaf, silver pointed leaf respectively), a dark brown base outline. NO writing, NO digits.
Style: authentic charming vanilla Stardew Valley inventory art, ACTUAL 16x16-pixel simplicity, big clean deliberate pixel clusters, one logical pixel warm dark outline, 3-4 tones per material, upper-left highlights, warm hue-shifted shadows. Glass berries use a few hard pixel highlights, not high-resolution rendering. Saturated but gentle colors. Strict consistent logical pixel size across all eight sprites.
Real transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no ground shadows, no typography, no labels, no grid lines, no frames, no decorative background. No blur, no antialiasing, no gradients, no painterly fine detail, no extra items. Precisely eight separate inventory sprites in the specified 4x2 grid.
